job.title: Accounts Officer
job.description:
Accounts All-Rounder | Western Sydney | $70k – $75k + Super | Western Sydney
 
The Company
Our client is a well-established and growing organisation operating within the construction and building materials sector. With a strong presence across Australia and continued business growth, they are looking for an Accounts All-Rounder to join their Western Sydney finance team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, has a strong eye for detail and is happy to roll up their sleeves and support a busy finance function.
 
The Role
Working as part of a collaborative finance team, you will provide hands-on support across Accounts Payable, Credit and Payroll, with a strong focus on data entry, processing transactions and assisting the team in clearing existing backlogs.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Processing high volumes of financial transactions and maintaining accurate records
  • Assisting with Accounts Payable, including invoice entry, matching and reconciliations
  • Supporting the Credit team with payment allocations, account queries and general administration
  • Assisting with payroll data entry, timesheets and payroll-related administration
  • Helping clear outstanding processing backlogs across the finance function
  • Investigating and resolving discrepancies as required
  • Maintaining accurate information within the finance system
  • Liaising with internal stakeholders to obtain information and resolve queries
  • Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team
 
The Candidate
We are looking for a reliable, organised and detail-focused Accounts All-Rounder who is comfortable working across different areas of finance and enjoys getting things done.
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Accounts All-Rounder or similar finance support role
  • Working knowledge of Accounts Payable, Credit/Accounts Receivable and Payroll processes
  • Strong data entry skills with a high level of accuracy
  • Experience processing high volumes of transactions
  • Good Excel skills and confidence using accounting systems
  • Exposure to SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or another large ERP system would be advantageous
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • A flexible, hands-on attitude and willingness to assist wherever needed
  • Good communication skills and a positive, team-focused approach
 
The Benefits
  • $70,000 – $75,000 + Superannuation
  • 6 month contract role that could extend
  • Western Sydney location, close to public transport
  • Join a well-established and growing national organisation
  • Supportive and collaborative finance team
  • Varied role with exposure to multiple areas of finance

job.title: Financial Controller - Commercial Flavour
job.description:
Financial Controller - Commercial Flavour
$190k plus super and bonus
Huntingwood location


This one’s for the finance leader who wants to build something and not just keep the lights on.

This is the Australian business of a European-owned industrial group. Locally it’s a lean, well-run operation, backed by a large international parent and a clear plan to grow significantly over the next few years. The systems are modern, the team is capable, and the MD wants a finance partner who’ll help him take the business to the next level.

The MD is after a sounding board and a straight talker. Someone who will dig into the numbers, find the gaps, question the status quo and tell him what the business needs to grow. You’ll be closely involved in setting up the ANZ entity structure, including the legal and governance side, working with external lawyers and advisors. This is a rare chance to help design a business and not just report on one.

The role
  • Work alongside the MD on growth strategy, pricing, margins and investment decisions
  • Spot commercial gaps and opportunities, and turn them into practical recommendations
  • Provide margin and performance insights across the business’s product and service lines
  • Help establish the ANZ entity structure, including corporate, legal and compliance requirements
  • Report to the local and international boards
  • Own budgets, forecasts and reporting to the overseas parent
  • Manage statutory accounts, audit, tax, treasury and banking relationships
  • Lead a small, hands-on accounting team of two
  • Oversee payroll and HR compliance across multiple states with external provider

About you
You’re a CA or CPA who started with strong technical foundations and has since moved into commercial finance leadership. You’ve worked for the local subsidiary of an overseas group and know how to manage both a local MD and a head office. A background in industrial, machinery, automotive or trading businesses will be a real advantage.
More importantly, you have the confidence to challenge, the curiosity to ask why, and the energy to be hands-on in a lean environment. If you see yourself as a future CFO who wants broad exposure across finance, legal, operations and people, this role will stretch you in all the right ways.

What’s on offer
  • Up to $190K base plus bonus
  • Direct partnership with the MD and visibility at board level
  • Broad remit covering finance, legal structure, operations and HR compliance
  • The backing of a substantial international group with the agility of a growing local business
  • Modern Western Sydney head office with on-site parking

job.title: Technical Sales / Business Development Manager
job.description:
Technical Sales / Business Development Manager
Civil & Industrial  $120K + Super + Commission + Company Vehicle
Western Sydney Office
up to $120,000 base + Super + Commission
Company Car + fuel & tolls
Approx. $12K–$15K commission p.a. at target, with further upside

Are you an experienced B2B sales professional who would rather be out in the market building relationships and winning business than sitting behind a desk?
This is an outstanding opportunity to take ownership of a substantial sales territory, representing a specialist range of engineered products and technical solutions used across civil construction, infrastructure, road, environmental and major project applications.

With an approximate 50/50 split between new business development and account management, you'll have established relationships to grow alongside plenty of opportunity to prospect, identify new projects, open doors and win new business.
This is a genuine territory sales role for someone who enjoys being in front of customers, understands project-based selling and has the drive to get out there and create opportunities.

The Role
You'll manage a large territory extending from Sydney through NSW and into northern Victoria, developing relationships across the civil and industrial sectors.
Expect to spend at least two days per week on the road, potentially more when the opportunities are there. This role comes with autonomy, and the right person will naturally want to be out meeting customers, visiting sites and developing their territory.
On road days there is flexibility to work from home around appointments. Non-field days are based in the Moorebank office.
Being reasonably local to Moorebank would be ideal, although there is flexibility for a strong candidate.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Managing and growing an established portfolio of customers
  • Prospecting and winning new business across your territory
  • Developing opportunities within civil, infrastructure and industrial markets
  • Building relationships with contractors, consultants, engineers and key project stakeholders
  • Identifying upcoming projects and following opportunities through the sales cycle
  • Visiting customers, construction sites and project locations
  • Understanding customer requirements and recommending appropriate technical solutions
  • Managing quotations, pricing and commercial negotiations
  • Developing opportunities through tenders and project specifications
  • Maintaining a strong pipeline and tracking opportunities through CRM
  • Keeping across competitors, market activity and upcoming projects
  • Working closely with your State Manager and wider internal team to drive territory growth
About You
We're particularly interested in sales professionals with experience across the civil, construction, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
You may already be selling technical or engineered products into contractors and project-based customers, or perhaps you're in an adjacent industrial sales environment and ready for a bigger territory and greater autonomy.
You'll ideally bring:
  • Proven B2B sales and business development experience
  • Exposure to the civil and/or industrial markets
  • A strong track record of winning new business as well as developing existing accounts
  • Confidence selling technical products, applications or solutions
  • Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills
  • A genuinely proactive approach to prospecting
  • Commercial confidence around pricing and negotiation
  • Strong territory and pipeline management skills
  • The ability to understand technical information and translate it into practical customer solutions
  • The flexibility and motivation to travel regularly throughout your territory
Above all, you'll be someone who likes to sell.
You're comfortable picking up the phone, making the introduction, getting in front of customers and developing a relationship over time. Equally, you'll understand the value of looking after existing customers and identifying where else you can add value.
What's On Offer?
Approximately 50/50 new business and account management
A substantial territory with genuine scope to grow
Autonomy to manage your territory and spend time where the opportunities are
A specialist technical product range servicing major civil, infrastructure and industrial applications
This isn't a role for someone who wants to spend five days a week behind a desk.
We're looking for a commercially driven, technically confident and energetic salesperson who enjoys getting out into the market, developing strong relationships and turning opportunities into business.
If you have experience within civil, infrastructure, construction or industrial sales and you're looking for a role offering a strong base salary, commission, a fully maintained company vehicle and plenty of autonomy, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Previous experience in a Credit Officer and Accounts Receivable role (B2B or trade credit experience is highly regarded)
  • Hands-on experience with banking, receipting and cash allocations
  • Confidence negotiating with customers by phone and email, while keeping relationships strong
  • Strong attention to detail and well-organised follow-up habits
  • Experience with an ERP systems and solid Excel skills
  • The ability to manage your own workload and meet deadlines
  • A team-player attitude, flexibility and a willingness to work closely with Sales and other teams

Join a globally recognised organisation with a strong international presence and established operations across Australia and New Zealand. With a focus on innovation, regional growth and operational excellence, the business continues to invest in its people, systems and capabilities.
An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Financial Controller to lead the Australian finance function, working closely with local leadership and global finance stakeholders. This is a hands-on leadership role offering the opportunity to influence business performance, strengthen financial processes and drive continuous improvement.

The Position
Reporting to the local CEO and Global Finance leadership, you will oversee financial operations, provide commercial insights and ensure strong financial controls and compliance. You will lead a small finance team while partnering with the wider business to support informed decision-making and improve operational performance.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning, providing insights to support business decisions and profitability.
  • Oversee monthly financial reporting, including P&L, balance sheet, operating expenditure and key performance indicators.
  • Analyse financial results and budget variances, identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Manage cash flow, working capital, aged debtors and payment processes.
  • Oversee tax compliance, statutory reporting and external audit requirements.
  • Maintain robust financial controls, ensuring accurate and reliable reporting.
  • Act as the key finance contact for HR matters, including employment agreements, new starter documentation, inductions and employee terminations.
  • Manage business insurance requirements, including workers compensation and ongoing compliance.
  • Supervise accounting, accounts payable and accounts receivable activities, providing team support and improving processes, workflows and master data management.
  • Oversee cash management and act as the primary authoriser for business payments.
  • Oversee inventory stocktakes, ensuring appropriate financial controls and audit compliance.
  • Manage end-to-end monthly payroll for more than 60 employees, including overtime and commission calculations
  • Build strong relationships with local management, global finance teams, auditors, banks and external advisers.
The Candidate
You are a commercially minded finance leader who combines strong technical accounting skills with the ability to see the bigger business picture. Comfortable operating at both a strategic and hands-on level, you can translate financial information into meaningful insights and build strong relationships across the organisation.
Ideally, you will bring:
  • CA/CPA qualification and experience in financial control or senior finance leadership.
  • Experience in manufacturing, distribution or a similar operational environment.
  • Proven experience leading and developing a finance team.
  • Experience working within an international group structure and liaising with overseas head office.
  • A track record of improving processes, systems and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills and commercial acumen, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders.
The Benefits
  • $160,000–$180,000 + superannuation.
  • Eastern Creek location with on-site parking.
  • Opportunity to lead a broad finance function with direct influence on business performance.
  • Exposure to local executive leadership and international finance stakeholders.
  • Join an established global organisation with a focus on innovation and growth.
  • The opportunity to develop your team, improve processes and contribute to ongoing business improvement.
